raw_definitions: Definisi : c. grow quickly , membesar dgn cepat: the boy has shot up during the last few years, budak itu telah membesar dgn cepat dlm beberapa tahun kebelakangan ini; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ up, a. increase sharply, melambung naik: coffee shot up to $16.00 a kilo within three months, harga kopi melambung naik kpd $16.00 sekilo dlm masa tiga bulan; b. rise sharply, meluncur naik: the rocket shot up into the sky, roket itu meluncur naik ke langit; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ o’s way out , merempuh keluar dgn menembak-nembak: the prisoners revolted and shot their way out of the camp, orang-orang tahanan memberontak dan merempuh keluar dr kem dgn menembak-nembak; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : ~ it out , (sl) bertembak-tembakan habis-habisan: the robbers shot it out with the police, perompak-perompak itu bertembak-tembakan habis-habisan dgn polis; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : he shot out a hand to prevent the child from running onto the road, dia menghulurkan tangannya utk menahan budak itu drpd lari ke jalan; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ out , see vi (sense 3. a.); ~ st out , (tongue) menjulurkan, menjelirkan; (hand) menghulurkan: the ant-eater ~s out its sticky tongue to catch termites, tenggiling menjulurkan lidahnya yg jeleket utk menangkap anai-anai; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : b. talk too freely, membuka mulut: someone must have been ~ing off his mouth to the newspapers, mesti ada orang yg telah membuka mulut kpd surat khabar; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ o’s mouth off, (US), (colloq) a. boast wildly, bercakap berdegar-degar: he’s always ~ing his mouth off about his nocturnal activities, dia selalu bercakap berdegar-degar ttg kegiatan malamnya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : b. see ~ away (sense b.); ~ st off, menembak putus sst: one of his fingers was shot off during the raid, salah satu jarinya ditembak putus dlm serbuan itu; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ off, a. (of person) leave quickly, pergi cepat: I have to ~ off now, I’ll talk to you tomorrow, saya kena pergi cepat sekarang, kita boleh bercakap lagi besok; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ o’s way into st, merempuh masuk sst dgn menembak-nembak: the terrorists shot their way into the embassy, para pengganas merempuh masuk kedutaan dgn menembak-nembak; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ into st, (with gun) menembak ke sst; (with bow and arrow) memanah ke sst: the policemen ~ into the air as a warning to the demonstrators, polis menembak ke udara sbg tanda amaran kpd penunjuk-penunjuk perasaan; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ st from st, (usu pass.) menembakkan sst dr sst: was this bullet shot from the murder weapon?, adakah peluru ini ditembakkan dr senjata yg digunakan dlm pembunuhan tersebut; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : b. demolish so’s idea etc by argument, mematahkan sst: I put forward my idea on how to cut costs but my partners shot it down, saya mengemukakan cadangan saya utk mengurangkan kos tetapi rakan kongsi saya mematahkannya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ st down, a. cause aircraft to fall by shooting, menembak jatuh sst: five of our planes were shot down in the battle, lima drpd kapal terbang kita ditembak jatuh dlm pertempuran itu; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ so. down, kill so. by shooting, menembak mati sso: he threatened to ~ down anyone who made a move, dia mengancam akan menembak mati sesiapa sahaja yg bergerak; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : b. move away quickly, cepat-cepat lari: the little boy shot away as soon as he saw me coming, budak kecil itu cepat-cepat lari sebaik sahaja melihat saya datang; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ away, a. fire away, menembak-nembak: we have been ~ing away for more than four hours. I think we should take a break, sudah empat jam lebih kita menembak-nembak. Saya rasa kita patut berhenti rehat; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ at /so. , st/, menembaki /sso, sst/: they ~ at bottles for practice, mereka menembaki botol sbg latihan; he claimed that someone had shot at him, dia mendakwa ditembaki orang; ~ a glance at, see vt (sense 7.); (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : b. do better than so., jauh/mendahului, mengatasi/ sso: once he learnt the language, the foreign boy shot ahead of the rest of his class, apabila telah belajar bahasa itu, pelajar asing tersebut jauh mendahului teman sekelasnya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ ahead of so., a. pass so. with sudden quick movement, memotong sso: the car behind shot ahead of us and pulled up abruptly, kereta di belakang memotong kami dan tiba-tiba berhenti; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : ~ the breeze, (US), (colloq) bersembang, berborak; ~ the lights, langgar lampu merah; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ a line, (colloq) temberang; ~ the bolt, a. slide bolt into its socket, menyelak, mengenakan selak: he closed the door and shot the bolt, dia menutup pintu dan menyelak kuncinya; b. slide bolt out of its socket, membuka selak; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : 9. (US), (billiards, craps, dice) (ber)main: let’s ~ some pool, mari kita main pool; 10. (sl) inject (heroin etc) into the bloodstream, jet, jab; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 8. make (motion picture) membuat, memfilemkan; (photograph) mengambil gambar: the new film is being shot in Spain, filem baru itu sedang dibuat di Sepanyol; the photographer has shot her from several angles, jurugambar telah mengambil gambarnya dr beberapa sudut; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 7. dart (a glance) melemparkan: she shot him an angry look, dia melemparkan pandangan marah ke arahnya; ~ so. a sideways glance, /menjeling, melirik, mengerling/ sso; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 6. propel, send rapidly, [various translations]: the horse balked, ~ing its rider over its head, kuda itu tiba-tiba berhenti, menyebabkan penunggangnya terhumban ke hadapan; the lift shot them up to the 25th floor, lif itu meluncurkan mereka ke tingkat 25; journalists shot questions at him, para wartawan melontarkan soalan-soalan kepadanya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 4. execute by shooting, menembak mati: the soldier was court-martialled and shot, askar itu dihukum oleh mahkamah tentera dan kemudiannya ditembak mati; 5. hunt, memburu: to ~ wild boar, memburu babi hutan; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 3. hit with missile from, a. (a gun) menembak: the policeman shot one of the bandits in the arm, polis menembak salah seorang penjahat itu pd lengannya; b. (a bow and arrow) memanah; c. (a blowpipe) menyumpit; ~ so. dead, menembak sso mati: two of the suspects were shot dead, dua drpd yg disyaki ditembak mati; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : b. (arrow ) memanahkan, melepaskan, melancarkan: I shot the arrow high into the air, saya melepaskan anak panah itu tinggi ke udara; c. (dart from blowpipe) menyumpitkan; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 2. discharge, a. (bullet) menembakkan: this machine-gun can ~ a hundred rounds per minute, mesingan ini boleh menembakkan seratus butir peluru seminit; the revolver ~s .45 calibre bullets, revolver itu menembakkan peluru kaliber .45; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : vt 1. fire (gun etc) menembak dgn, menembakkan: during the war even children were trained to ~ a rifle, semasa perang, kanak-kanak pun dilatih menembak dgn senapang; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 5. try to score a goal, mencuba menjaringkan gol: “S~!”, (gen) “Masuk!” , “Gol!”; (in football) “Tendang!”; (in hockey) “Pukul!”; 6. send out new shoots, bertunas, bertaruk; (at apex of plant or end of branch) berpucuk, bertaruk: the bean seed sends down a root before it starts to ~, biji kacang mengeluarkan akar sebelum bertunas; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : 4. make a film, membuat penggambaran: while we are ~ing there must be absolute silence, semasa kita membuat penggambaran, semua orang mesti betul-betul diam; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : h. (of thought, image, etc) terlintas: when he heard the siren memories of the war shot across his mind, apabila mendengar bunyi siren ingatan masa perang terlintas di kepalanya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : d. (of flame) menyembur; e. (of lift) meluncur: the lift shot up to the twentieth floor without stopping, lif itu meluncur naik ke tingkat dua puluh tanpa berhenti; f. (of lightning) memancar; g. (of pain) mencucuk: a sharp pain shot up his right leg, rasa sakit yg mencucuk naik pd kaki kanannya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : little speedboats ~ing over the water, bot-bot laju yg sedang meluncur di permukaan air; a rocket shot into the air, sebuah roket meluncur ke udara; c. (of water) memancut: the jet of water that shot from the nozzle knocked him over, air yg memancut dr muncung hos itu menyebabkan dia jatuh; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : the cat shot out of the door with the dog after it, kucing itu meluru keluar pintu, dikejar oleh anjing; b. (of vehicle) memecut, meluru, meluncur; (on water or in the air) meluncur: he put his foot hard on the accelerator and the car shot forward, dia menekan minyak dgn kuat dan kereta itu meluru ke depan; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 2. hunt, berburu: they have gone to Padang Terap to ~, mereka ke Padang Terap utk berburu; 3. move with sudden quick movement, a. (of person, animal) meluru: a cyclist shot out from a side street right into the path of an approaching truck, seorang penunggang basikal meluru keluar dr lorong dan melintas betul-betul di hadapan sebuah lori yg sedang lalu; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ on sight, menembak sebaik sahaja /sso kelihatan, melihat sso, sso dilihat/: the escaped convicts are armed and we have orders to ~ on sight, banduan-banduan yg melarikan diri itu bersenjata dan kami diperintah menembak sebaik sahaja mereka kelihatan; ~ to kill, menembak utk membunuh; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : vi 1. fire bullets from gun, menembak: hands up or I’ll ~!, angkat tangan, kalau tdk saya tembak!; for a beginner, he ~s very well, bagi orang yg baru belajar, dia cukup pandai menembak; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 2. (shooting trip ) perburuan, memburu; (shooting party) kumpulan pemburu: they spent the afternoon at a duck ~ in the nearby marshes, mereka menghabiskan waktu petang memburu itik di paya yg berdekatan; the ~ moved off before dawn, kumpulan pemburu itu bertolak sebelum fajar; 3. area of land on which game is shot, kawasan perburuan: you need to be rich to own a ~ those days, dahulu seseorang mestilah kaya utk memiliki kawasan perburuan; 4. (US) see CHUTE. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. young stem with leaves , tunas, taruk; (at apex of plant or end of branch) pucuk, taruk; (of bamboo) rebung: the cattle will eat the ~s unless the trees are fenced off, lembu akan memakan pucuk kalau pokok-pokok itu tdk dipagari; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
